text: Plate twelve. The ostrich: Struthio camelus.
The eye, magnified: the largest of any land animal, fringed with double lashes.
The brain, drawn beside the eye that dwarfs it: smaller than either eye.
The foot: two toes only, where every other living bird has three or four.
A grown cock stands two metres seventy, and a single stride covers three full metres.
The cock digs the nest, and the hen by day and the cock by night keep the largest egg of any living bird.
